GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 410.2 (4 Apr 47) CPC/GP
(SCAPIN - 1599)
APO 500
4 April 1947
MEMORANDUM FOR : IMPERIAL JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Tokyo.
SUBJECT : Gold, Silver and Platinum for Domestic Consumption in the First Quarter of 1947.
1. Reference is made to Memorandum for the imperial Japanese Government, file AG 410.2(15 Mar 47)CPC/GP, SCAPIN 1572, 15 March 1947, subject: Gold, Silver, and Platinum for Domestic Consumption in the First Quarter of 1947.
2. The period during which the subject allocation of precious metals may be used is extended to include the Second Quarter of 1947.
3. The following corrections are made to reference memorandum:
a. Nippon Toki Kooki, K. K,; allocation of 1,283 grams of silver is deleted and cancelled.
b. Nippon Toki, K.K. is allocated 1,283 grams of silver.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
JOHN B. COOLEY,
Colonel, AGD,
Adjutant General.
